sloka: वपुःप्रकर्षेण ववुर्दिव्यमारुतपङ्क्त्यः ।बभञ्ज च तदा वृक्षान् जलदानुद्वहन् मुहुः ॥६-२२-१०॥।।
transliteration: vapuḥprakarṣeṇa vavurdivyamārutapaṅktyaḥ ।babhañja ca tadā vṛkṣān jaladānudvahan muhuḥ ॥6-22-10॥।।

translations.english: Then terrific wind blew breaking forth the clouds, which is an abode of cold water, taking them away in upward direction breaking trees.
